lifecycleReview.eventSource: PASS: the back rail dispatches only after it has established a same-origin referrer and only for an unmodified primary-button history.back action; its detail is the parsed referrer pathname, not an arbitrary href.
lifecycleReview.eventValidation: PASS for product flow: player accepts only a nonempty slash-leading pathname, normalizes it, and consumeContinuation requires it to equal the actual returned pathname. The custom event is not a security boundary against arbitrary same-page scripts.
lifecycleReview.nonBfcache: PASS: ordinary mount already calls beginNavigationHandoff(consumeContinuation()), so the one-use handoff is handled on a full document reload.
lifecycleReview.bfcache: PASS: persisted pageshow uses beginNavigationHandoff(consumeContinuation()). The executed harness proves a current owner consumes the original record into pending storage, retains it through ownership, and exposes that original intent once after release.
lifecycleReview.expiredFutureWrongPath: PASS by source inspection: consumeContinuation rejects missing, expired, future, nonplaying, and destination-mismatched records, then removes the record.
lifecycleReview.wrongOrigin: PASS for generated event path: sv-back-nav only enables internal return when refURL.origin equals location.origin. The player stores no origin because it receives only the already-validated pathname.
lifecycleReview.otherOwner: PASS: beginNavigationHandoff follows a current owner rather than hydrating or starting local audio; it preserves pending validated intent for later release.
lifecycleReview.deliberatePause: PASS: record state has playing false for paused/non-owned audio, and consumeContinuation refuses it; no autoplay follows a deliberate pause.
lifecycleReview.nativeBack: PASS: a browser-native Back action does not dispatch the custom return event. An existing forward-navigation record targets the forward destination and fails the returned-path comparison, leaving restoration paused.
